verdict.rationale: Raygun ships an in-product AI chat (AI Resolution, OpenAI-powered), so it is fair to ask whether it can act as an MCP client. However, no evidence shows it can connect to external MCP servers or use their tools. The only MCP evidence is an official Raygun MCP server (mcp-server-raygun), which is the server role and cannot be credited to this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
